segments.speaker: Nurse
segments.text: Patient in room 4 is unresponsive! No breathing!

segments.speaker: Team Leader
segments.text: Start CPR. Attach the defibrillator pads.

segments.speaker: Defib Coach
segments.text: Pads attached. Analysing rhythm — it's VF.

segments.speaker: IV Member
segments.text: IV access established. Epinephrine 1 mg given.

segments.speaker: Team Leader
segments.text: Think about reversible causes — Hs and Ts.

segments.speaker: Airway
segments.text: Possible hypoxia — I've been bagging at good rate.

segments.speaker: Defib Coach
segments.text: Third shock delivered. Rhythm looks organised.

debrief_segments.speaker: Instructor
debrief_segments.text: Okay team, let's take a moment to debrief. Well done overall — that was a good resuscitation. What do you think went well today?

debrief_segments.speaker: Team Leader
debrief_segments.text: I think we maintained CPR quality throughout. The compressor never paused too long.

debrief_segments.speaker: Instructor
debrief_segments.text: Excellent observation. The chest compression fraction was indeed very good. What about areas where we could improve?

debrief_segments.speaker: Nurse
debrief_segments.text: I think we should have established IV access faster. It took about 3 minutes.

debrief_segments.speaker: Instructor
debrief_segments.text: That's a great point. IV access at 3 minutes 30 seconds was slightly delayed. The target is within 2 minutes in the ICU. How could we improve that next time?

debrief_segments.speaker: IV Member
debrief_segments.text: I'll ensure I'm positioned at the IV trolley as soon as the arrest is called.

debrief_segments.speaker: Instructor
debrief_segments.text: Good plan. The Hs and Ts discussion was timely — that's a strength. Did everyone feel the communication was clear? Closed-loop confirmations?

debrief_segments.speaker: Airway
debrief_segments.text: The read-backs were consistent from our end.

debrief_segments.speaker: Instructor
debrief_segments.text: Excellent. To summarise: strong CPR quality and communication were your standout strengths. IV access timing is the key learning point. Well done team — debrief complete.
